changes.reason: Sitemap validation scans UTF-16 code units without allocating character arrays and indexes canonical identities by resource and locale without serializing repeated JSON keys. The same control-character exclusions, canonical approval calls and conflict decisions, XML bytes, ordering and publication limits are preserved. No Host, storage, lifecycle or public API changes.

kubernetes.reason: This change only removes intermediate allocations from pure string validation; it introduces no platform capabilities or changes to the existing sitemap publication coordinator.
constraints: Existing filesystem publication restrictions and runtime claims remain unchanged.

changes.reason: Generated Next.js applications use supported Next.js 16.4.1 and patched Sharp 0.35.5. Explicit Webpack commands retain existing Babel transforms; the OpenNext version-support guard remains enforced. The generator adds no Host or provider and has no catalog runtime claims.

kubernetes.reason: The generator emits a supported Next.js major and keeps the Webpack build used by existing Node frontend templates. This does not exercise a Kubernetes Node Host.
constraints: Generated install, typecheck and build checks are local artifact evidence; no cluster deployment or container runtime certification is claimed.

aws-lambda.reason: The Next.js frontend dependency and bundler selection do not change the separately generated Lambda backend, its invocation scope, packaging or flush ownership.
constraints: Frontend artifact checks do not certify a live Lambda deployment.

cloudflare.reason: The generated OpenNext app uses Next.js 16 within the existing adapter support range and keeps the adapter support check enabled. Worker artifact builds are distinct from deployed Worker and provider conformance.
constraints: Local Worker artifact builds do not certify Cloudflare deployment, database bindings or other provider compatibility.
